about: measure contests of 2018 in Alaska, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, 2018 precinct-level returns, GitHub MEDSL/2018-elections-official at commit 42055b11dcd5
medsl.licence: no licence file in the repository; MEDSL's Dataverse sets of the same year are CC0 1.0
medsl.note: MEDSL's own earlier release, read by git (the repository now points to its Dataverse sets, which sit behind a guestbook; pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py --compare-dataverse matches the files by MD5); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2018-ak-precinct-general.zip

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

threshold.rule: majority of the votes cast on the proposition (exactly half is not a majority)
threshold.quote: If a majority of the votes cast on the proposition favor the amendment, it shall be adopted.
threshold.matched: the source's title does not give the type; every rule read for the state's measures (but its convention question) sets this threshold

p.not_computed: fewer than 100 like measures in earlier years in the sources taken in (83) for the class 'statewide measure'

notes: counted by county: MEDSL's wording of a local question does not show which place holds it, so a question held across several counties appears once per county

p.not_computed: a local retention: its threshold is the one state law sets for its kind of judge, which the source's wording does not show, and the place that holds it is not shown either (it is counted by county); not inferred (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 06:16)
